text:
maya: hey folks — first week here, hitting a weird MDM + encryption edge case on my MBP M2 (Ventura). I dual-booted Ubuntu for a dev workflow. I just finished the kandji enrollment and it shows the DiskEncryption profile applied, but System Settings -> Privacy & Security shows FileVault is Off.

ben: curious — what does `fdesetup status` show? sometimes the UI lags after MDM pushes configs.

maya: ran it, output below:
```
$ fdesetup status
FileVault is Off.
```
but kandji-bot shows escrow key uploaded and profile `com.redwood.disk-encrypt` applied. Confusing because the KB we have says enrollment should enable FV.

it-support: thanks @maya. two quick notes: 1) dual-boot setups can confuse our onboarding script if the EFI got touched during Ubuntu install. 2) candji/kandji-bot sometimes reports profile pushed but the user approval flow may still be pending in System Settings (look for a banner at the top). Can you paste `profiles status -type configuration` (redact anything sensitive)?

maya: pasting the relevant bits (sanitized):
```
PayloadIdentifier: com.redwood.disk-encrypt
Status: Installed
UUID: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
```

karen: if the profile is installed but FileVault is Off, we usually escalate to a remote session — we need to see if the MDM can trigger `fdesetup enable` or if user consent is blocked by the boot setup. Also check System Settings -> General -> Login Items for a Kandji prompt app.

maya: I don't see any kandji prompt. No popup appeared. Is it safe for you folks to enable FV remotely? I'm happy to approve a temp-admin session if needed.

it-support: we can run a safe checklist first: please run `diskutil apfs list` and `sudo /usr/bin/last reboot` then paste outputs. If those look normal, we can request a short remote session. If you prefer, file a support ticket with "MDM encryption not enabling after enrollment (dual-boot)" and we'll schedule 30m.

maya: here's `diskutil apfs list` truncated:
```
APFS Container (1 found):
  +-- Container disk1  (synthesized)
  +-- Physical Store disk0s2
  |   APFS Volume Macintosh-HD - Data
  |   APFS Volume Macintosh-HD
```
no obvious third-party crypt setup.

ben: one more thought — if Ubuntu changed the ESP/boot order, the Recovery OS path might be nonstandard and `fdesetup` could refuse to enable FV until recovery is fixed. I've seen that before.

it-support: okay, @maya — can you open a Lighthouse ticket? tag `it-support` and include: mac model, macOS version (Ventura), short description, and mention you dual-booted. I'll triage and we can do a remote session. In the meantime don't install anything that touches the EFI.

maya: filed: https://lighthouse.redwood.com/tickets/12345 — summary: "MBP M2 Ventura dual-boot enrolled in MDM but FileVault not enabled". assigned to it-support. Thanks for the quick help. :pray:

karen: noted. once we get remote, we'll either trigger FV enable via MDM or provision a temp-admin flow for you to allow it manually. We'll keep it short.

kandji-bot: Disk encryption profile `com.redwood.disk-encrypt` verified as installed for device. Key escrow present.

it-support: closing loop here for visibility — we'll update the ticket with steps and outcome. thanks @maya for the details.

maya: thanks everyone — appreciate the help! :heart:
